about-this-demo.md.title: About this demo
about-this-demo.md.summary: A fictional roastery's wiki, to try browsing, the brain and questions before adding your own documents.
about-this-demo.md.html:
This wiki belongs to Lumen Coffee Roasters, a small roastery in Turin that does not exist. It was written to show what an LLM wiki looks like after a few months of use:

  • every note sits in a folder the librarian chose, and each folder is described in its parent's index;
  • related notes are joined by See also links, drawn as red dashes in the Brain view;
  • every note keeps the source it was written from, under raw/.

Browse the folders on the left, open the Brain, or ask a question such as "What did we decide about prices in May?" (asking needs a model: set one in Settings). Drop your own files and they are filed next to these notes; this copy of the demo is yours to change.

customers/cafe-portello.md.title: Café Portello
customers/cafe-portello.md.summary: Wholesale customer since 2024: 18 kg a week of Aurora; wants training on decaf.
customers/cafe-portello.md.html:
A café near Porta Nuova, and one of the largest wholesale customers.

  • Buys about 18 kg of Aurora a week and 2 kg of Night Shift.
  • Pays at 30 days, always on time.
  • Asked for barista training on decaf, which extracts faster than their usual recipe.

Contact is the owner; deliveries on Wednesday morning.

See also

  • Wholesale café onboarding - New cafés get a tasting, a 2 kg trial, a grinder calibration visit, and 30-day payment after three orders.
  • Night Shift decaf - Swiss Water decaf from Colombia Huila; 12% of subscription orders.

customers/refund-policy.md.title: Refund policy
customers/refund-policy.md.summary: Refunds within 30 days of delivery; damaged bags are replaced without sending them back.
customers/refund-policy.md.html:
• Customers can ask for a refund within 30 days of delivery.
  • Damaged or open bags are replaced without asking for the bag back: a photo is enough.
  • Subscriptions can be refunded for the last delivery only.

Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 working days.

See also

  • Carriers and delivery times - Parcel carrier for Italy in 1-2 days and the EU in 3-5; free shipping over €45 in Italy.

customers/subscription-churn-q2-2026.md.title: Subscription churn, Q2 2026
customers/subscription-churn-q2-2026.md.summary: Churn was 6.1% a month in Q2 2026; people leave mostly because they have too much coffee, then because of price.
customers/subscription-churn-q2-2026.md.html:
From the cancellation form, April to June 2026 (212 cancellations):

Reason Share
Too much coffee at home 41%
Price 23%
Moving or travelling 14%
Taste 9%
Other 13%

Most people leaving because of volume would have stayed with a pause option.

See also

  • Pause instead of cancel - Offer a one- or two-month pause on the cancellation page, to keep subscribers who have too much coffee.
  • Pricing meeting, May 2026 - Retail up 8% and wholesale up 5% from 1 July; decaf keeps its margin; subscriptions keep their discount.

customers/wholesale-cafe-onboarding.md.title: Wholesale café onboarding
customers/wholesale-cafe-onboarding.md.summary: New cafés get a tasting, a 2 kg trial, a grinder calibration visit, and 30-day payment after three orders.
customers/wholesale-cafe-onboarding.md.html:
How a new café becomes a wholesale customer:

  1. Tasting at the roastery with the owner and the head barista.
  2. A 2 kg trial of Aurora at wholesale price.
  3. A visit to calibrate the grinder and the espresso recipe.
  4. Payment on delivery for the first three orders, then 30 days.

Wholesale prices are in the price list; the minimum order is 5 kg.

See also

  • Café Portello - Wholesale customer since 2024: 18 kg a week of Aurora; wants training on decaf.
  • Price list from July 2026 - Retail and wholesale prices from 1 July 2026, after the rise in green coffee prices.

ideas/cold-brew-cans.md.title: Cold brew cans
ideas/cold-brew-cans.md.summary: A pilot of 500 cans with a co-packer, if the shelf-life test passes.
ideas/cold-brew-cans.md.html:
Cold brew made with Ethiopia Guji, sold in 250 ml cans.

  • A co-packer can fill small runs from 500 cans.
  • A shelf-life test (90 days, refrigerated) is needed before selling.
  • Target price: €3.50 a can in cafés.

Approved as a pilot by the board in June 2026.

See also

  • Board meeting, June 2026 - Approved a study for a second roaster, a cold brew pilot and a part-time packer.
  • Ethiopia Guji, seasonal single origin - Washed Guji lot, floral and citrus, sold from March to August while the lot lasts.

ideas/pause-instead-of-cancel.md.title: Pause instead of cancel
ideas/pause-instead-of-cancel.md.summary: Offer a one- or two-month pause on the cancellation page, to keep subscribers who have too much coffee.
ideas/pause-instead-of-cancel.md.html:
41% of cancellations in Q2 2026 were from people with too much coffee at home.

Proposal: the cancellation page first offers to pause for one or two months, or to switch to a delivery every two weeks.

Similar shops report keeping a third of the people who would have cancelled.

See also

  • Subscription churn, Q2 2026 - Churn was 6.1% a month in Q2 2026; people leave mostly because they have too much coffee, then because of price.

ideas/roastery-tours.md.title: Roastery tours
ideas/roastery-tours.md.summary: Saturday tours with a cupping session for 12 people at €15 each.
ideas/roastery-tours.md.html:
Open the roastery on Saturday mornings:

  • a one-hour tour of the roaster and the green coffee store;
  • a cupping of three coffees, led by the head roaster;
  • 12 people at most, €15 each, with 10% off coffee bought on the day.

It could bring new subscribers from the neighbourhood.

See also

  • Quality control and cupping - Every batch is cupped the day after roasting; below 82 points a coffee is not sold as single origin.

meetings/board-meeting-june-2026.md.summary: Approved a study for a second roaster, a cold brew pilot and a part-time packer.
meetings/board-meeting-june-2026.md.html:
Approved

  1. A study of a second roaster, since the current one runs at 85% of capacity.
  2. A cold brew pilot of 500 cans, if the shelf-life test passes.
  3. Hiring a part-time packer for subscription day.

Not approved: opening a second shop; to be discussed again in 2027.

meetings/pricing-meeting-may-2026.md.title: Pricing meeting, May 2026
meetings/pricing-meeting-may-2026.md.summary: Retail up 8% and wholesale up 5% from 1 July; decaf keeps its margin; subscriptions keep their discount.
meetings/pricing-meeting-may-2026.md.html:
Decisions

  • Retail prices up 8% from 1 July 2026.
  • Wholesale up 5% only, to keep the cafés.
  • Subscriptions keep the 10% discount.

Why: the July price fixings for green coffee came in 11% higher.

Actions: update the price list and the web shop; email wholesale customers one month ahead.

See also

  • Price list from July 2026 - Retail and wholesale prices from 1 July 2026, after the rise in green coffee prices.
  • Subscription churn, Q2 2026 - Churn was 6.1% a month in Q2 2026; people leave mostly because they have too much coffee, then because of price.

operations/roasting/aurora-roast-profile.title: Aurora roast profile
operations/roasting/aurora-roast-profile.summary: Charge at 205 °C, first crack at 9:10, drop at 11:30, with 1:45 of development.
operations/roasting/aurora-roast-profile.html:
The reference profile for 12 kg batches of Aurora on the 15 kg roaster.

Step Time Bean temperature
Charge 0:00 205 °C (drum)
Turning point 1:25 92 °C
Yellowing 4:40 160 °C
First crack 9:10 196 °C
Drop 11:30 208 °C

Development time is 1:45 (about 15% of the roast). Weight loss should be 14-15%. If first crack comes before 8:45, lower the gas by one step at yellowing.

See also

  • Aurora espresso blend - House espresso: 60% Brazil Cerrado and 40% Ethiopia Guji, medium roast; the best seller.
  • Roaster maintenance - Chaff cleaned weekly, exhaust monthly, burner serviced yearly; the roaster runs at 85% capacity.

operations/roasting/quality-control-and-.title: Quality control and cupping
operations/roasting/quality-control-and-.summary: Every batch is cupped the day after roasting; below 82 points a coffee is not sold as single origin.
operations/roasting/quality-control-and-.html:
Quality checks on every roast day:

  • Each batch is cupped the next morning against the reference sample.
  • Colour is measured on ground coffee (Agtron).
  • A single origin scoring below 82 goes into blends instead.

Faults are written in the roast log with the batch number, so a customer complaint can be traced back to the roast.

See also

  • Ethiopia Guji, seasonal single origin - Washed Guji lot, floral and citrus, sold from March to August while the lot lasts.
  • Roastery tours - Saturday tours with a cupping session for 12 people at €15 each.

operations/roasting/roaster-maintenance..title: Roaster maintenance
operations/roasting/roaster-maintenance..summary: Chaff cleaned weekly, exhaust monthly, burner serviced yearly; the roaster runs at 85% capacity.
operations/roasting/roaster-maintenance..html:
The 15 kg roaster runs four days a week.

  • Weekly: empty and clean the chaff collector.
  • Monthly: clean the exhaust duct (a fire risk if skipped).
  • Yearly: burner service and thermocouple calibration by the manufacturer.

It already runs at about 85% of its capacity: the board asked for a study of a second roaster.

See also

  • Aurora roast profile - Charge at 205 °C, first crack at 9:10, drop at 11:30, with 1:45 of development.
  • Board meeting, June 2026 - Approved a study for a second roaster, a cold brew pilot and a part-time packer.

operations/shipping/carriers-and-deliver.summary: Parcel carrier for Italy in 1-2 days and the EU in 3-5; free shipping over €45 in Italy.
operations/shipping/carriers-and-deliver.html:

  • European Union: 3-5 working days, €12.90.

operations/shipping/subscription-packing.title: Subscription packing day
operations/shipping/subscription-packing.summary: Subscriptions are roasted on Monday, packed on Tuesday morning and shipped on Tuesday afternoon.
operations/shipping/subscription-packing.html:
Subscriptions go out once a week so the coffee is always fresh:

  1. Monday: roast every coffee needed for the week's subscriptions.
  2. Tuesday morning: pack and label; about 420 bags a week.
  3. Tuesday 15:00: the carrier collects.

Packing takes two people for a full morning, which is why a part-time packer is being hired.

See also

  • Carriers and delivery times - Parcel carrier for Italy in 1-2 days and the EU in 3-5; free shipping over €45 in Italy.

products/aurora-espresso-blend.md.title: Aurora espresso blend
products/aurora-espresso-blend.md.summary: House espresso: 60% Brazil Cerrado and 40% Ethiopia Guji, medium roast; the best seller.
products/aurora-espresso-blend.md.html:
Aurora is the house espresso and about 45% of all coffee sold.

Component Share Why
Brazil Cerrado, natural 60% body, chocolate, low acidity
Ethiopia Guji, washed 40% florals and a citrus finish

Roasted medium (Agtron 58-60) so it works both as espresso and with milk. Recommended recipe: 18 g in, 38 g out, 27-30 seconds.

Sold in 250 g and 1 kg bags; cafés buy it in 5 kg bags.

products/ethiopia-guji-seasonal-single-o.title: Ethiopia Guji, seasonal single origin
products/ethiopia-guji-seasonal-single-o.summary: Washed Guji lot, floral and citrus, sold from March to August while the lot lasts.
products/ethiopia-guji-seasonal-single-o.html:
The seasonal single origin for 2026 comes from the same washing station that supplies the Guji in Aurora.

  • Process: washed, dried on raised beds.
  • Cupping score at arrival: 86.5.
  • Notes: jasmine, bergamot, peach.
  • Volume: 1,800 kg; about 40% is kept for Aurora, the rest is sold as filter coffee.

It is roasted light for filter and sold only in 250 g bags.

products/night-shift-decaf.md.title: Night Shift decaf
products/night-shift-decaf.md.summary: Swiss Water decaf from Colombia Huila; 12% of subscription orders.
products/night-shift-decaf.md.html:
Night Shift is decaffeinated with the Swiss Water process (no solvents), from a Huila lot bought through Andes Direct.

  • Tasting notes: caramel, red apple, cocoa.
  • Roasted a little darker than Aurora, because decaf beans take heat faster and brown early.
  • 12% of subscription orders, rising every winter.

Wholesale cafés often ask for training on it: decaf needs a slightly coarser grind.

See also

  • Andes Direct, importer - Main importer for Brazil and Colombia lots: FOB contracts, payment at 60 days.
  • Café Portello - Wholesale customer since 2024: 18 kg a week of Aurora; wants training on decaf.

sourcing/andes-direct-importer.md.title: Andes Direct, importer
sourcing/andes-direct-importer.md.summary: Main importer for Brazil and Colombia lots: FOB contracts, payment at 60 days.
sourcing/andes-direct-importer.md.html:
Andes Direct supplies all Brazilian and Colombian green coffee.

  • Contracts are FOB, with shipping to Genoa arranged by the importer.
  • Payment at 60 days from delivery.
  • Minimum order: one pallet (about 1,150 kg).
  • Samples arrive two weeks before each shipment and are cupped before the contract is signed.

About 70% of the expected yearly volume is bought at fixed prices, as set out in the hedging policy.

See also

  • Green coffee price hedging - Prices are fixed for six months on 70% of the expected volume; the rest is bought at market.
  • Night Shift decaf - Swiss Water decaf from Colombia Huila; 12% of subscription orders.

sourcing/green-coffee-price-hedging.md.title: Green coffee price hedging
sourcing/green-coffee-price-hedging.md.summary: Prices are fixed for six months on 70% of the expected volume; the rest is bought at market.
sourcing/green-coffee-price-hedging.md.html:
Green coffee is the largest cost, and its price moved by more than 30% in a year.

The rule since January 2026:

  1. Every six months, estimate the volume needed from sales.
  2. Fix the price for 70% of it with the importers.
  3. Buy the remaining 30% at the market price when needed.

This kept costs stable in the first half of 2026, but the July fixings came in higher, which is why retail prices change from July.

See also

  • Price list from July 2026 - Retail and wholesale prices from 1 July 2026, after the rise in green coffee prices.
  • Andes Direct, importer - Main importer for Brazil and Colombia lots: FOB contracts, payment at 60 days.

sourcing/guji-washing-station-visit-febr.title: Guji washing station visit, February 2026
sourcing/guji-washing-station-visit-febr.summary: Notes from the visit to the Guji washing station: capacity, cupping and the 2026 contract.
sourcing/guji-washing-station-visit-febr.html:
Two days at the washing station in February 2026.

  • About 900 smallholder farmers deliver cherries; the station processes 60 tonnes a season.
  • Lots were cupped on site: the best washed lot scored 86.5 and was bought for the seasonal single origin.
  • A new drying area with raised beds should cut defects next season.

Agreed for 2026: 1,800 kg at a price fixed on the day of signature, delivered by May.

See also

  • Ethiopia Guji, seasonal single origin - Washed Guji lot, floral and citrus, sold from March to August while the lot lasts.

answers.question: What did we decide about prices in May?
answers.html:
In the May 2026 pricing meeting, the following decisions were made regarding prices:

  • Retail prices: Increase by 8% starting 1 July 2026 .
  • Wholesale prices: Increase by 5% starting 1 July 2026 (to keep the cafés) .
  • Subscriptions: Maintain their 10% discount .

answers.question: How long do customers have to ask for a refund?
answers.html: Customers can ask for a refund within 30 days of delivery .

answers.question: Why do subscribers cancel, and what could keep them?
answers.html:
Based on Q2 2026 cancellation data, subscribers cancel for the following reasons :

  • Too much coffee at home: 41%
  • Price: 23%
  • Moving or travelling: 14%
  • Taste: 9%
  • Other: 13%
What could keep them:
  • A pause option: Most subscribers leaving due to volume would have stayed if offered a pause option . Specifically, offering a one- or two-month pause on the cancellation page, or switching to delivery every two weeks, could keep subscribers who have excess coffee . Similar shops report retaining a third of people who intended to cancel using this method .

(Note: The notes do not provide solutions or retention ideas for the other cancellation reasons, such as price, moving/travelling, or taste.)

answers.question: How is a subscription order roasted and shipped?
answers.html:
Subscription orders follow a weekly schedule :

  1. Roasting (Monday): Every coffee needed for the week's subscriptions is roasted . Quality checks include cupping each batch the next morning against a reference sample and measuring ground coffee colour with Agtron .
  2. Packing (Tuesday morning): Bags are packed and labeled (around 420 bags per week) .
  3. Shipping (Tuesday at 15:00): The carrier collects the parcels .

Delivery takes 1–2 working days for Italy and 3–5 working days for the European Union . Specific roast profiles depend on the bean (for example, the reference profile for Aurora uses a 12 kg batch on the 15 kg roaster with a 205 °C charge and a drop at 11:30) .
